task.description:
WF-03 Step 4c — wire the new iss0123 regression test into build.zig.

The test file tests/integration/iss0123_regression_test.zig exists but is not yet wired into build.zig. Pattern to follow: see iss0125_cascade_test.zig (also added recently, same shape).

Required actions:
1. Read build.zig and find the test-integration-* blocks (search for "iss0125_cascade" to see the wiring pattern).
2. Add a parallel block for "iss0123_regression" following the same pattern:
   - b.addTest() with the source file tests/integration/iss0123_regression_test.zig
   - Any required b.addRunArtifact wiring
   - Any required barrier entry to make it run as part of test-integration-tm
3. Validate: zig build exits 0, zig build test exits 0, zig build test-integration-tm builds the new test (or at least shows it in the test graph).
4. Commit and push:
   - git add -A
   - git commit -m "chore(WF03-gh389): wire iss0123_regression_test into build.zig"
   - git push origin feature/WF03-gh389-20260802
5. Self-review per BACKEND-DEV protocol.

When done:
- Set handoff status: "COMPLETED"
- Fill result.status: "PASS", result.summary: "Wired iss0123 test into build.zig", result.artifacts_out: ["build.zig"], result.issues: [], result.next_action: "Route to TEST-RUNNER (Step 5)"
- Set completed_at to current ISO8601 timestamp from: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import datetime; print(datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'))"
- Update handoffs/registry.json for the new handoff_id (set status to COMPLETED)
- Append to handoffs/orchestrator.log: <ts> | COMPLETE | WF03-gh389-20260802 | <id> | BACKEND-DEV | PASS
- IMPORTANT: registry.json must use open(..., encoding='utf-8') (NOT 'utf-8-sig'). Use \n (not CRLF) line endings.

Allowed commands: zig build, zig build test, zig build test-integration-tm, ripgrep, replace_string_in_file, multi_replace_string_in_file, create_file, read_file, file_search, grep_search, run_in_terminal, git, gh. NO git push --force, NO git push to main, NO rm -rf.
